lines.text: Nothing alive in North America can catch this animal.
The pronghorn can hit fifty-five miles an hour, and keep running for miles. Wolves and coyotes top out near forty.
So what is it running from? A ghost.
Until about twelve thousand years ago, these plains were hunted by the American cheetah. Scientists think the pronghorn got this fast escaping it.
Then that cheetah vanished. But the pronghorn never slowed down. Which is why, today...
